Agent 自动化中台\n\n agent-autoloop init [--:
Agent automation hub

  agent-autoloop init [--agent claude|codex] [--command 'some command {prompt}'] [--port 3350] [--no-service]
                                    Set this computer up: one computer per person is enough
  agent-autoloop try                     Run the whole flow with your Agents
  agent-autoloop why <round> [--json]  See the timeline of a round; --json prints the raw facts
  agent-autoloop conformance <address> --config <test credentials file>
                                    Check the protocol against a test hub
  agent-autoloop status [--json]         What is happening now: who is online, what waits for you, what runs, what ran, what it cost
                                     --json prints the raw /v1/state structure, for scripts
  agent-autoloop runs [rule] [--before <round>] [--json]
                                    List finished rounds, one rule only if you say, paging back; details with why
  agent-autoloop answer <card> [choice] [--text another idea]
                                    Answer a card; a notice takes no choice
  agent-autoloop resolve <card> <result>   This needs no decision any more; write one line of outcome
  agent-autoloop doctor                  Check what is not set up right
  agent-autoloop check [file]            Check a rules file without touching the hub; no file means rules.json
  agent-autoloop rules explain [file]    Walk through the rules, Agents, channels and next schedules in the rules.json of this machine (or a named draft)
  agent-autoloop pause <rule> [--reason why] [--until time]
                                    Pause a rule: nothing runs when due, no events are taken, until resumed
  agent-autoloop resume <rule>
                                    Resume; missed windows do not run later
  agent-autoloop run <rule> [--subject what] [--reason note]
                                    Run one round now, queued and dispatched as usual
  agent-autoloop emit <type> [--dry-run] [--subject x] [--summary x] [--detail x] [--link x] [--id x] [--key source key]
                                    Send an event; --dry-run only rehearses who would get it, without connecting to the hub
  agent-autoloop tell <number> [--task task name]
                                    Tell you a thing directly, content read from stdin
  agent-autoloop ask --task <task name>
                                    A scheduled task asks you a thing: stdin carries an ask like a receipt; your answer wakes its Agent in cwd to carry on
  agent-autoloop stop <round>           Stop a round
  agent-autoloop key new <source|worker|channel|owner> <name>
                                    Mint a key (shown only this once)
  agent-autoloop key list                Which keys there are
  agent-autoloop key remove <kind> <name>  Revoke a key at once
  agent-autoloop add <git address>           Install a plugin; no auto-update
  agent-autoloop mcp                      Talk to an MCP client over standard input and output
  agent-autoloop join <hub address> --worker <name> --key <key> [--no-service]
                                    For another computer that only takes work
  agent-autoloop backup [directory]           Back up the database, master key, config, rules and secrets.env; no directory means ~/.agent-autoloop/backups
  agent-autoloop restore <directory> [--yes]  With the hub stopped, restore the data of this machine from one backup
  agent-autoloop update                  Update to the newest published release
  agent-autoloop uninstall [--yes]       Uninstall the program and keep the data; --yes skips the confirmation
  agent-autoloop --version               Version and current commit
  agent-autoloop help                    This text
  agent-autoloop up                      Start (the system service calls it normally)
  agent-autoloop service install|remove  The system service

Config and data live in {"home"}. Rules live in {"rules"}; edits take effect at once.

Usage: agent-autoloop init [--agent claude|codex] [--command 'some command {prompt}'] [--port 3350] [--no-service]

  --agent      Take only this Agent: claude or codex. Without it, every one installed on this machine
  --command    Use a different command-line Agent instead; {prompt} is passed as one separate argument, quote paths with spaces;
               if the program is not found on this computer, nothing is installed
  --port       The port the hub listens on, 3350 by default
  --no-service Do not install the system service yet; run agent-autoloop up by hand afterwards
